req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a new task should be persisted in the database and retrievable via subsequent GET requests. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful task creation, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to check the behavior at the edge of valid input constraints.

tests.name: test_create_task_success
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with valid task data.
expected: Response payload matches the created task data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "A task for testing", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Test Task"
assert response.json()["description"] == "A task for testing"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_invalid_data
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with invalid task data (missing title).
expected: Receive HTTP 422 response indicating validation error.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "A task without a title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of maximum allowed length (100 characters).
expected: Response payload matches the created task data with the long title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

long_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": long_title, "description": "Boundary test for title length", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == long_title
assert response.json()["description"] == "Boundary test for title length"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
